findings.claim: 10-K 列出 Power Systems 主要對手為 Caterpillar、MTU、Kohler/SDMO，另有 INNIO、Generac、三菱重工；Engine 段獨立引擎對手為 Weichai、Yuchai、Deutz。
findings.excerpt: Our primary competitors are Caterpillar, Inc., MTU (Rolls Royce Power Systems Group) and Kohler/SDMO (Kohler Group), but we also compete with INNIO, Generac, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries and numerous regional generator set assemblers.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：替代技術（天然氣、氫、電動）持續發展，公司將面對這些新技術帶來的新競爭；新興市場客戶出口後可能與公司既有客戶競爭。
findings.excerpt: We primarily compete with diesel engines and related diesel products; however, new technologies continue to be developed for gasoline, natural gas, hydrogen, electrification and other technologies, and we will continue to face new competition from these expanding technologies.

findings.claim: 搜尋摘要：資料中心發電機市場研究稱 Caterpillar 2025 年占比逾 19%；未找到 Cummins 2026 年份額增減的一手數據。
findings.source: GM Insights data center generator market（經搜尋摘要）
findings.excerpt: Caterpillar Inc. led with over 19% market share in 2025.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 未找到 2026 年 Cummins 份額消長方向的可靠來源，也未查到具名新進入者搶單；只有 10-K 對手清單與第三方粗估。聚合站份額數字互相矛盾，未採用。
